limits: Independent recorded-data recomputation; no pretrained neural replay, training or human semantic validation.
Recorded EOS tensor origin, tokenizer decoding and source-token counts are not cryptographic proof; pinned code/artifacts and actual-scorer characterization bound that claim.
All original recorded lexical alternatives are replayed; lexical acceptance does not establish wiring, negation or mounting semantics.
The diagnosed sixteen intents, known t09 regression and shared gallery are not a new independent holdout.
Warm semantics reconstruct from scored attempts plus ranking overrides; every saved timing/status/digest is checked, not independently reinferred.
Finalized diagnostic sequence length may be shorter than actual process/callback steps; scorer.is_done may skip the final callback.
Protection suppresses an abort and continues the unchanged search; it does not guarantee the final selected output succeeds.
Closed-log hashes depend on all external writers finishing; this auditor excludes only its own stdout/stderr inodes.
